title: AWS accounts and the root user

kcs.statement: An AWS account is a container for resources that acts as a billing and security boundary: by default resources in one account are isolated from other accounts.
The root user is the identity created with the account's sign-up email address and has full access to every resource and the billing settings, which IAM policies cannot restrict.
Some tasks require the root user, including changing the root email or password, closing the account, restoring an IAM administrator's lost permissions, and enabling MFA Delete on an S3 bucket.
